sources.title: ITC Immunity Therapy Center — Alternative Cancer Treatment
facts: ITC is in Tijuana, Mexico, minutes across the U.S. border, and was founded by Dr. Carlos Bautista.
The approach begins with medical-record review, then individual planning, treatment explanation, daily monitoring, follow-up support, and coordination with the patient's existing doctors.
Eligibility depends on cancer type, stage, organ function, previous treatment, medical history, and physical strength; qualified physicians review records before acceptance.
The base standard multi-week program starts at $18,995 USD; total cost varies with duration, therapies, and diagnostic needs.

Standard inclusions listed on the profile include physician consultations and daily care, a customized therapy suite, daily IV nutrition and natural supplements, monitoring and nursing care, local transportation assistance, and companion support.
The clinic is near San Diego International Airport and its page says dedicated shuttle services support border crossings and local transit.
The page says outcomes vary and patients should discuss risks and combinations with qualified physicians and avoid delaying necessary standard treatment without consulting their oncologist.

sources.title: Alternative Adenocarcinoma Cancer Treatment in Tijuana
facts: The 3-week out-patient program is $18,995 USD and the 3-week in-patient program is $30,000 USD.

Out-patient includes weekly lab work, one prescribed X-ray, ultrasound, or CT scan, standard program therapies, two health-focused meals on treatment days, standard protocol medications, and one follow-up consultation after three months.

In-patient includes 24/7 medical supervision, private room and board, three meals daily, weekly diagnostics, one prescribed imaging study, program therapies, protocol medications, and a follow-up consultation after three months.
Optional procedures cost extra, including LAK cells at $2,600 USD and intratumoral immunotherapy at $6,200–$7,200 USD.
Specialty medications, external specialist consultations, surgery or biopsies, blood products, emergency services, additional imaging, and home programs are excluded or may cost extra.
The typical itinerary is evaluation and initiation in week 1, intensive therapy in week 2, and consolidation and home-care planning in week 3.

sources.title: Alternative Medicine Cost Abroad — Compare Prices 2026
facts: The page reports an average alternative-medicine cost abroad of $15,032 USD and a quoted range of $64–$30,000 USD, last verified June 3, 2026.

Starting estimates shown are $200–$800 for acupuncture, $800–$2,500 for 14-day Ayurvedic Panchakarma, $500–$1,500 for ozone therapy, $3,000–$10,000 for alternative stem cell therapy, and $1,200–$4,000 for a naturopathic wellness retreat.
Typical inclusions may include assessment, a personalized plan, therapy sessions, prescribed supplements, dietary meals for residential care, mind-body activities, and lifestyle coaching.
International flights, outpatient hotel accommodation, long-term refills, emergency care, and travel or complications insurance are often not included.
The page says estimates vary and recommends requesting a personalized quote.
